message: 24M. I rolled my ankle playing basketball last night. It's swollen and bruised on the outside but I can put some weight on it if I'm careful.
title: 24M. I rolled my ankle playing basketball last night. It's swollen and bruised on the outside but I…

physician.note: The physician retains clinician review. Some weight-bearing does not establish a negative Ottawa ankle assessment; rule eligibility and required criteria are not established by the message. This is not an asserted positive Ottawa result or a confirmed fracture.

fable.rationale: Lateral ankle sprain with swelling/bruising but able to bear weight; no red flags (deformity, inability to bear weight, numbness). RICE, elevation, OTC analgesics; seek care if unable to walk 4 steps, bony tenderness, or no improvement in several days.

medgemma.rationale: Injury requires medical evaluation but not emergent.

v25.rationale: Isolated lateral ankle inversion injury with swelling, bruising and preserved partial weight-bearing is consistent with a sprain manageable with self-care and a clear action-based safety net.

nano-r1.rationale: Ankle injury with swelling/bruising, able to bear weight carefully—non-urgent but requires evaluation for possible sprain/ligament injury.

nano-r2.rationale: Ankle injury with swelling/bruising, able to bear weight carefully—non-urgent but requires evaluation for possible sprain/ligament injury.

astra-xhigh.rationale: Symptoms suggest an ankle sprain, with some weight-bearing possible and no clear urgent red flags reported.

astra-max.rationale: Likely ankle sprain with some weight bearing and no clear red flags reported. Inability to walk four steps or tenderness directly over bone warrants same-day assessment.
